surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the sequential pulsing of Ta(OEt)5 and ZrCl4 precursors, with ozone (O3) used as an oxygen source. The reactions likely involve the formation of surface hydroxyl groups, followed by the reaction of the metal precursors with these groups, leading to the formation of Ta-O-Zr bonds and the removal of byproducts such as HCl and CH4.
